name: u09-cold-start-deploy-storm
about: Cold start, reconstruction and a deploy storm across one account's 35 objects (objects.ndjson of the restored copy). Each object is evicted after 70 s idle (plan 03 U09 T_evict); the first request after that pays recover(). Records: 695 per object = the second account's 24,263 own records spread over 35 objects, kind mix execution 46% (777 B), resource-command-result 45% (322 B), trigger-dispatch-outcome 8% (186 B) [S o26]. Requests: 300 commands/day per seat (plan A-TYP) over 35 objects = 8.6/object/day, 86% reads [P o21: 86% of gate permits are reads], all day (founder gate active 18-24 h/day [P]). Measured idle gaps: founder 0.17% of permits after > 70 s, second account 7.6% [P]. Deploy storm: every object restarts inside one 60 s window once a day (plan F7 '1,000 objects cold within 60 s' at one account's 35 objects; the deploy rate itself is not in the copy). Sources: [A] 04-every-table-challenged.md; [P] clone queries on o08/o21/o27/o04/o07/o09 (profile-overhead lane, 2026-10-27); [L] clone queries o03 record_log 2026-10-20..22 PDT, o04 namespace_names, o21 account_control_permits operations (4 load days 2026-10-15..23); [S] --seed-from profile: founder o03 2,398,695 current records / 178 kinds, second account o26 24,263 records. Typical sizes come from the second account [S o26] where the kind exists there, else the founder [S o03].
